Name: Strange Cosmos - Astronomy and Space Furniture
Author: Kamidevo
Description:
Strange Cosmos adds new space-themed content to Stardew Valley, including new decor, new minerals, new recipes, treasure hunting, and a working telescope.

Place the Old Telescope outside and use it at night to take photos of the sky. The undeveloped photos can then be processed inside the Darkroom Box, turning them into collectible night sky photos. Some photos are common, while others are much rarer.

You can also find a new mineral, the Star Rock, through artifact spots and geodes. Star Rock can be donated to the museum, appears in the mineral collection, and gives new museum rewards when donated.

The Signal Receiver adds a new way to search for cosmic treasures. Place the Signal Receiver and use it once per day to receive strange broadcasts. Some signals are simple radio messages, some give small astronomy hints, and some point you toward a mysterious Cosmic Crater somewhere in the valley. Find the crater and dig it up with a hoe to uncover space-themed loot.

Cosmic Craters can contain Star Rocks, rare Glowing Star Rocks, and sometimes cosmic furniture. Glowing Star Rock is a rare mineral that can be donated to the museum or sold for a high price.

Current content:
8 space-themed furniture and decor items
Old Telescope photography system
Darkroom Box photo development system
Signal Receiver radio system
Cosmic Crater treasure hunting system
8 collectible night sky photos with different rarities
New Star Rock minerals
New crafting materials and space-themed items
New crafting recipes
Natural Star Rock mineral spawns from artifact spots and geodes
Rare cosmic treasure rewards from craters

Compatibility:
Tested with Stardew Valley Expanded
Designed to be vanilla-friendly
Mostly adds new content instead of replacing existing vanilla content

Requirements:
SMAPI
Content Patcher

Installation:
Unzip the file into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

Your Mods folder should contain:
StrangeCosmos
[CP] StrangeCosmos

Then launch the game through SMAPI.

Planned future content:
More space and alien-themed decor
More photo types
Telescope minigame
Star maps and constellations
Observatory building
More alien mystery content
